records.name: Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC)
records.description: Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC) New Delhi, established in 1965 under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, is India's premier institution for journalism and mass communication education. It offers postgraduate diploma programs in English journalism, Hindi journalism, advertising and public relations, and radio and television journalism, training hundreds of media professionals annually. IIMC has campuses in Dhenkanal, Aizawl, Amravati, Kottayam, and Jammu, and its alumni lead India's major newsrooms and media organizations.

records.name: Asian College of Journalism
records.description: Asian College of Journalism (ACJ) Chennai, established in 2000, is one of India's most respected journalism schools offering a postgraduate program in journalism. It is known for its rigorous reporting and writing training, strong visiting faculty from leading Indian and international newsrooms, and focus on digital journalism and data journalism. ACJ alumni work across India's and Asia's leading print, broadcast, and digital media organizations.

records.name: Symbiosis Institute of Media and Communication
records.description: Symbiosis Institute of Media and Communication (SIMC) Pune is a leading media school under Symbiosis International University offering MBA, MA, and BSc programs in media and communication. It is known for its practical training infrastructure including professional TV studios, radio stations, and digital media labs, preparing students for careers in broadcast journalism, advertising, public relations, and digital media. SIMC consistently ranks among India's top communication schools.

records.name: Times School of Journalism
records.description: Times School of Journalism New Delhi, associated with The Times Group, India's largest media conglomerate, offers postgraduate programs in journalism, advertising, and media management. The school provides students direct industry exposure through Times of India newsrooms and other Times Group properties. It is known for its practical, industry-embedded training that prepares students for immediate entry into print, digital, and broadcast journalism.

records.name: National Law School of India University (NLSIU)
records.description: National Law School of India University (NLSIU) Bangalore, established in 1987, is India's first and most prestigious National Law University, consistently ranked number one among law schools in the country. Its flagship 5-year BA LLB (Hons) program is among the most competitive in India, admitting students through the CLAT examination. NLSIU alumni occupy leading positions as advocates at the Supreme Court, partners at top law firms, corporate counsel, and in academia.

records.name: Government Law College
records.description: Government Law College (GLC) Mumbai, established in 1855, is India's oldest law college and one of its most prestigious, affiliated with the University of Mumbai. It offers LLB and LLM programs and is known for producing generations of India's most distinguished lawyers, judges, and public figures, including several freedom fighters and Supreme Court luminaries. GLC's rich heritage and Mumbai's status as India's legal and financial capital make it a highly sought-after institution for legal education.

records.name: Arena Animation
records.description: Arena Animation is one of India's largest animation and visual effects training networks, with centers in over 60 cities offering programs in 2D/3D animation, VFX, game design, and digital filmmaking. It provides short-term and long-term courses aligned with industry requirements, using global curriculum developed in collaboration with technology partners. Arena Animation has trained hundreds of thousands of animation professionals who work in Indian and international animation studios.

records.name: College of Art Delhi
records.description: College of Art Delhi, established in 1942, is one of India's oldest and most respected fine arts colleges, affiliated with Indraprastha University. It offers BFA and MFA programs across painting, sculpture, applied arts, and art history, attracting students from across India. The college's location in the capital city provides exceptional access to national museums, galleries, and the arts community, enriching students' artistic development.

records.name: Kala Bhavana Santiniketan
records.description: Kala Bhavana, Visva-Bharati University, Santiniketan, was founded by Rabindranath Tagore in 1919 as a revolutionary arts and crafts institution that reimagined Indian art education by blending traditional Indian artistic traditions with modernist approaches. It offers BFA, MFA, and PhD programs in painting, sculpture, printmaking, and history of art, and is recognized as one of India's most creatively significant art institutions. Kala Bhavana's unique outdoor classroom tradition and association with Tagore's legacy make it a pilgrimage destination for artists and art lovers.

records.name: Government College of Fine Arts Chennai
records.description: Government College of Fine Arts Chennai, established in 1850, is one of Asia's oldest fine arts colleges, affiliated with the University of Madras and offering BFA and MFA programs. It is known for its strong traditions in South Indian classical painting, sculpture, and applied arts, training generations of Tamil Nadu's leading artists and art educators. The college's historical legacy and government support make it a premier destination for fine arts education in South India.
